newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: RTRS-Australia Sept manufacture input prices fall.
newsitem.headline: RTRS-Australia Sept manufacture input prices fall.

text.p: The prices of materials used in Australian manufacturing fell 0.5 percent in September from August and stood 4.1 percent lower than a year before, the Australian Bureau of Statistics said on Friday.
"The increase in the value of the Australian dollar led to price falls for a range of imported materials," the bureau said.
"These, together with further price falls for sheep and wheat, were the main contributors to the decrease in the index," it said.
The overall decrease was partly offset for the month by price increases for crude oil and cattle, it said.
Other major movements included falls in sheep prices due to market oversupply, falls in wheat prices and lower prices for imported chemicals.
